description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Live Hyperliquid funding (1h, 8h, APR), direction, premium, mark/oracle price, open interest and 24h volume. Optional coin filter and limit. Returns JSON Hyperliquid funding (1h, 8h, APR), direction, premium, mark and oracle price, open interest, and 24h volume.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

coin.description: Optional Hyperliquid coin filter. Format: a coin symbol. Example: BTC. Omit for every coin.

limit.description: Maximum coins to return. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Omit for the server's current cap.
